current_checkpoint.name: Fractal FM9-family Enhancer mono-to-stereo browser routing

official_source.title: Fractal Audio Systems Blocks Guide
official_source.qualification: The guide cover is dated June 2023 and covers FM9-family hardware; it lists two Enhancer instances for FM9. Firmware v12.0 names FM9 Original and FM9 Turbo, not Mark II Turbo by name; installed firmware is unknown.

current_checkpoint.documented_controls: Modern uses frequency-based left/right separation with Width, Depth, Low Cut, and Hi Cut and can convert mono to stereo with reduced phase risk when summed to mono. Classic uses a right-channel delay with Width 0–20 ms, Invert, Pan L/R, and Balance. Stereoizer uses high-order filters with Width and Depth. The guide publishes no numeric bounds/defaults beyond Classic Width.
current_checkpoint.project_controls: Existing Enhancer picker row/index 61 and project-authored Modern/Classic/Stereoizer DSP, ranges, and defaults are retained. The in-place one-channel core processor remains pass-through. In the browser, an enabled Modern Enhancer on mono input now builds a two-channel chain and duplicates the mono input before processing; other mono chains remain mono. Worklet disposal destroys the old WASM chain before a layout rebuild.

verification.fixture_safety: 11 audio-fixture safety checks passed using existing local prerecorded audio
verification.browser_native_comparison: 71 active stages passed; max absolute error 0.000007167997807755455, RMS error 0.0000013553611043218413
verification.mono_modern_browser_playback: actual browser worklet capture from 12,000 frames of local prerecorded Guitar-TECHS DI: mono input, stereo output, peak 0.2993818521499634, mean left/right difference 0.05708991683481145
verification.notes: Tests verify project routing and playback only. No Fractal DSP/settings/sound parity, human listening, physical device check, installed firmware, or isolated Enhancer CPU benchmark is claimed.
